ai_conversations.ddl:
CREATE TABLE ai_conversations (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(256), 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	current_pending_action VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	session_context_json TEXT, 
	last_message_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

ai_message_decisions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE ai_message_decisions (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	intent VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	follow_up_type VARCHAR(32), 
	target_case_id INTEGER, 
	confidence FLOAT, 
	needs_clarification BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	decision_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	engine_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_message_id) REFERENCES ai_messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_case_id) REFERENCES recycling_cases (id)
)

ai_messages.ddl:
CREATE TABLE ai_messages (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	message_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	content_text TEXT, 
	content_json TEXT, 
	related_analysis_id INTEGER, 
	sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_ai_messages_conversation_sequence UNIQUE (conversation_id, sequence_no), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(related_analysis_id) REFERENCES waste_analysis_records (id)
)

content_topic_assignments.ddl:
CREATE TABLE content_topic_assignments (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	domain VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	content_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	confidence_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_content_topic_assignments_content_topic UNIQUE (domain, content_type, content_id, topic_id)
)

forum_comments.ddl:
CREATE TABLE forum_comments (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	post_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	parent_comment_id INTEGER, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(post_id) REFERENCES forum_posts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(parent_comment_id) REFERENCES forum_comments (id)
)

forum_post_chunks.ddl:
CREATE TABLE forum_post_chunks (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	post_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	chunk_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	section_title VARCHAR(256), 
	chunk_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	embedding_id VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(post_id) REFERENCES forum_posts (id)
)

forum_posts.ddl:
CREATE TABLE forum_posts (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	author_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	image_urls_json TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

likes.ddl:
CREATE TABLE likes (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	target_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_likes_user_target UNIQUE (user_id, target_type, target_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

market_items.ddl:
CREATE TABLE market_items (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	seller_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	image_urls_json TEXT, 
	price_points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(seller_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

notifications.ddl:
CREATE TABLE notifications (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	recipient_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	is_read BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recipient_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

orders.ddl:
CREATE TABLE orders (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	item_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	buyer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	seller_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	price_points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(item_id) REFERENCES market_items (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(buyer_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(seller_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

project_contributions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE project_contributions (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	project_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

projects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE projects (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	creator_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	cover_image_url VARCHAR(512), 
	points_target INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	points_raised INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	deadline_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(creator_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

recycling_audit_attempts.ddl:
CREATE TABLE recycling_audit_attempts (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	recycling_case_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	audit_image_url VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	audit_result VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	auditor_confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	audit_reason TEXT, 
	audit_response_json TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_recycling_audit_attempt_case_attempt UNIQUE (recycling_case_id, attempt_no), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recycling_case_id) REFERENCES recycling_cases (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_conversations (id)
)

recycling_cases.ddl:
CREATE TABLE recycling_cases (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	origin_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	waste_type_predicted VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	estimated_weight_kg FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	expected_co2_saved_kg FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	expected_carbon_points FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	latest_audit_attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	approved_analysis_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_conversations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(origin_message_id) REFERENCES ai_messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(approved_analysis_id) REFERENCES waste_analysis_records (id)
)

recycling_stations.ddl:
CREATE TABLE recycling_stations (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	address VARCHAR(256), 
	latitude FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	longitude FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

transactions.ddl:
CREATE TABLE transactions (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	points_delta INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	co2_delta_kg FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

user_behavior_events.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_behavior_events (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	domain VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	action_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR(32), 
	target_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_payload_json TEXT, 
	context_json TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

user_memory_items.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_memory_items (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	memory_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	memory_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	value_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	source_message_id INTEGER, 
	conversation_id INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_message_id) REFERENCES ai_messages (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_conversations (id)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_user_memory_items_user_status_type_key ON user_memory_items (user_id, status, memory_type, memory_key)

user_preference_profiles.ddl:
CREATE TABLE user_preference_profiles (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	profile_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	profile_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	raw_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	normalized_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	confidence_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	event_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_domains_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	last_event_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_user_preference_profiles_user_profile_key UNIQUE (user_id, profile_type, profile_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

users.ddl:
CREATE TABLE users (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	avatar_url VARCHAR(256), 
	bio TEXT, 
	total_carbon_amount FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	current_points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	preferences_json TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (username), 
	UNIQUE (email)
)

waste_analysis_records.ddl:
CREATE TABLE waste_analysis_records (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id INTEGER, 
	recycling_case_id INTEGER, 
	approved_audit_attempt_id INTEGER, 
	image_url VARCHAR(256), 
	waste_type VARCHAR(64), 
	confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	estimated_weight_kg FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	co2_saved_kg FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	carbon_points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	raw_ai_response_json TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_conversations (id)
)
